head_commit.message:
Allow native launch attempts alongside shared graph readers

Use shared parent locks for prepare and record while preserving the existing target locks, launch identity, control fences and physical closure protocol.

Add real PostgreSQL contention controls and native process-loss evidence. Preserve coordinator health reports in runtime diagnostics and keep full volume acceptance open.
